# One Point Construction

One Point Construction is a commercial and multifamily contractor founded in 2016. The company provides roofing, siding, gutters, interior finishes, cabinetry, trim, doors, and painting for projects across Indiana, Ohio, Oklahoma, Georgia, and Florida.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://onepointconstruction.com/): Company overview, service area, and quote request.
- [Services](https://onepointconstruction.com/services.html): Exterior and interior construction services.
- [Team](https://onepointconstruction.com/team.html): Leadership and project-delivery team.
- [Projects](https://onepointconstruction.com/gallery.html): Commercial and multifamily project gallery.
- [FAQ](https://onepointconstruction.com/faq.html): Common questions about services, licensing, quotes, and subcontractor partnerships.

## Contact
